import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MODULUS = 998244353;
    static BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
    static StringTokenizer st;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        int n = readInt();
        int[] rock1_sci1_paper1 = readNumbers();
        int[] rock2_sci2_paper2 = readNumbers();

        int rock1 = rock1_sci1_paper1[0], sci1 = rock1_sci1_paper1[1], paper1 = rock1_sci1_paper1[2];
        int rock2 = rock2_sci2_paper2[0], sci2 = rock2_sci2_paper2[1], paper2 = rock2_sci2_paper2[2];

        int maxScore = getMax(rock1, sci1, paper1, rock2, sci2, paper2);
        int minScore = findMinScore(rock1, sci1, paper1, rock2, sci2, paper2);
        System.out.println(minScore + " " + maxScore);
    }

    static int getMax(int r1, int s1, int p1, int r2, int s2, int p2) {
        return Math.min(r1, s2) + Math.min(s1, p2) + Math.min(p1, r2);
    }

    static int getMatch(int a, int b) {
        if (a == b) return 0;
        if ((a == 1 && b == 2) || (a == 2 && b == 3) || (a == 3 && b == 1))
            return 1;
        else
            return -1;
    }

    static int computeScore(List<int[]> l1, List<int[]> l2) {
        int total = 0;
        int c1 = 0, c2 = 0;
        while (!l1.isEmpty() || !l2.isEmpty()) {
            try {
                if (c1 == 0) {
                    c1 = l1.remove(l1.size() - 1)[0];
                }
                if (c2 == 0) {
                    c2 = l2.remove(l2.size() - 1)[0];
                }
            } catch (IndexOutOfBoundsException e) {
                return total;
            }
            int matchScore = Math.max(0, Math.min(c1, c2) * getMatch(l1.isEmpty() ? 0 : l1.get(l1.size() - 1)[1], l2.isEmpty() ? 0 : l2.get(l2.size() - 1)[1]));
            total += matchScore;
            if (c1 < c2) {
                c2 -= c1;
                c1 = 0;
            } else if (c1 > c2) {
                c1 -= c2;
                c2 = 0;
            } else {
                c1 = c2 = 0;
            }
        }
        return total;
    }

    static int findMinScore(int r1, int s1, int p1, int r2, int s2, int p2) {
        List<int[]> perms1 = generatePermutations(new int[][] { { r1, 1 }, { s1, 2 }, { p1, 3 } });
        List<int[]> perms2 = generatePermutations(new int[][] { { r2, 1 }, { s2, 2 }, { p2, 3 } });
        int minAns = Integer.MAX_VALUE;
        for (List<int[]> p1Perm : perms1) {
            for (List<int[]> p2Perm : perms2) {
                List<int[]> p1Copy = deepCopy(p1Perm);
                List<int[]> p2Copy = deepCopy(p2Perm);
                int score = computeScore(p1Copy, p2Copy);
                if (score < minAns) {
                    minAns = score;
                }
            }
        }
        return minAns;
    }

    static List<int[]> generatePermutations(int[][] array) {
        List<int[]> result = new ArrayList<>();
        permute(array, 0, result);
        return result;
    }

    static void permute(int[][] array, int start, List<int[]> result) {
        if (start == array.length) {
            int[] perm = new int[array.length * 2];
            for (int i = 0; i < array.length; i++) {
                perm[2 * i] = array[i][0];
                perm[2 * i + 1] = array[i][1];
            }
            result.add(perm);
            return;
        }
        for (int i = start; i < array.length; i++) {
            swap(array, start, i);
            permute(array, start + 1, result);
            swap(array, start, i);
        }
    }

    static void swap(int[][] array, int i, int j) {
        int[] temp = array[i];
        array[i] = array[j];
        array[j] = temp;
    }

    static List<int[]> deepCopy(List<int[]> list) {
        List<int[]> copy = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int[] arr : list) {
            copy.add(arr.clone());
        }
        return copy;
    }

    static int[] readNumbers() throws IOException {
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int[] nums = new int[3];
        for (int i = 0; i < 3; i++) {
            nums[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        }
        return nums;
    }

    static int readInt() throws IOException {
        return Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
    }
}
